录像不能读出实时温度。黄色来自发光的烟炱，蓝色包含化学发光；颜色不能单独当温度计: A recording has no live probe readings. Yellow light comes from glowing soot; blue includes chemiluminescence. Color alone is not a thermometer.

温度、燃料、烟炱和速度来自这团火的网格。点测使用相邻网格的插值，木柴内部不提供气: Temperature, fuel, soot and velocity come from this fire's grid. Probes interpolate neighboring cells; readings inside solid wood are withheld.
可用空气 = 1 − 燃料 − 产物与惰性气体。它不是氧气浓度；若假设新鲜空气中: Available air = 1 minus fuel minus products and inert gas. It is not oxygen concentration. Assuming 23.2% oxygen by mass in fresh air gives an estimated oxygen mass fraction.
放热图显示燃烧引起的升温率，单位 K/s，不是温度，也不是整团火的 kW。气体会: The heat-release map shows combustion heating in K/s, not temperature or whole-fire kW. Radiation and mixing cool the gas at the same time.
蓝光是放热驱动的化学发光近似；模型没有逐个求解 CH*、C₂*、OH 或 CO₂: Blue light approximates chemiluminescence driven by heating. The model does not resolve CH*, C2*, OH or CO2 molecules. Color and brightness undergo camera-like processing.
剖面是一个位置的原始模拟场；实景是整条视线的光叠加，并加了细节噪声。两种颜色不能: The section samples raw fields at one location. The natural view combines light along each ray and adds detail noise. Their colors do not represent the same per-pixel quantity.
热解气从固定的木柴表面供给。模型没有木柴内部传热、消耗、水或分子扩散，不能直接当: Fixed log surfaces supply pyrolysis gas. Internal wood heating, fuel depletion, water and molecular diffusion are absent, so this is not an extinction or microgravity predictor.
涡量由投影前的速度差分换算；它和最终速度的采样时刻相差一个求解步骤。: Vorticity is converted from pre-projection velocity differences, one solver stage earlier than the final velocity.

15–50 ms是模型的烟炱生成门限；还需要足够高的温度。年龄记录燃料来源气体的: Soot formation ramps up at gas ages of 15–50 ms in this model, and also needs sufficient heat. Age tracks fuel-derived gas, not temperature.
上升的火舌会收细、断开。烟炱烧掉或冷却后，可见的光就弱下来了。: Rising tongues narrow and break away. As soot oxidizes or cools, their visible glow fades.

年轻气体还没积起很多烟炱。模型在气体年龄15–50毫秒时逐渐开启烟炱生成；微弱蓝: Young gases have accumulated little soot. This model ramps up soot formation at gas ages of 15–50 ms; faint blue light comes from chemiluminescence.

木头先失去水分，受热后又分解出可燃气。眼前的火焰主要烧的是这些气体。: Wood loses moisture, then heat breaks it down into combustible gases. Those gases feed most of the visible flame.

炭也在燃烧。氧接触炭表面，让裂缝和余烬发红；这里读的是炭床上方的气体温度。: Char burns too. Oxygen reacting at its surface makes cracks and embers glow. This reading is gas temperature above the coal bed.
点切口上的任何位置，读出温度、烟炱和年龄。: Tap anywhere on the cut to read temperature, soot and gas age.
烟里有没烧完的颗粒和凝结物。热气还含许多看不见的气体；这个模型没有各气体的独立浓: Smoke contains unburned particles and condensates. The plume also carries invisible gases; their individual concentrations are not resolved here.
热气向上，周围的空气补进来。横切后，朝火心的箭头就是卷吸进来的空气。: Hot gas rises and surrounding air flows inward. On the horizontal section, arrows pointing toward the fire show entrainment.
热烟炱发出黄光。亮度还受颗粒多少和视线厚度影响，最亮不一定最热。: Hot soot emits yellow light. Particle abundance and optical depth also affect brightness, so brightest need not mean hottest.
被气流带起的小炭粒一边飞，一边继续氧化，最后熄灭。读数来自当前存活的火星粒子。: Small char fragments rise in the flow, keep oxidizing and eventually go dark. Readings come from currently live spark particles.
40秒里，一半时间有火的最高一层。: The highest layer containing flame at least half the time over 40 seconds.
“加柴”增加可燃气供给，木柴几何不变。: Add fuel increases gas supply; the logs keep their shape.
一个甲烷与两个氧分子，变成一个二氧化碳和两个水分子。原子没有消失，只是换了连接方: One methane and two oxygen molecules become one carbon dioxide and two water molecules. No atoms disappear; their bonds change.

它积分ρcp·q，使用反应后的温度；温度上限与密度近似使它不等于化学放热。两者都: It integrates rho·cp·q using post-reaction temperature. The temperature cap and density approximation make it differ from chemical heat release. Neither is experimental calorimetry.
把每格燃料消耗相加，假定有效热值14 MJ/kg、密度353/T kg/m³。克: Sum fuel consumption over all cells, assuming 14 MJ/kg effective heat and density 353/T kg/m³. Grams are equivalent combustible gas at that heat value, not weighed wood. Each kettle is rated at 2 kW.

真实失重下，烛火可依靠分子扩散成为小圆球。这个模型没有算分子扩散，源流和湍流仍在: In microgravity, candle flames can become small spheres sustained by molecular diffusion. This model omits that diffusion and retains source flow and turbulence; this is not a reproduction of NASA’s experiment.
真实的热解气是许多种气体的混合物，这里用最简单的甲烷来说明。动画合并了许多反应步: Real pyrolysis gas is a mixture of many gases. Here methane provides a simple example. The animation combines many reaction steps.
纤维素、半纤维素和木质素受热断裂，放出一大群小分子和焦油，留下炭。: Heat breaks down cellulose, hemicellulose and lignin into gases and tar, leaving char behind.
绝干木头的燃烧热约18–20 MJ/kg；这团火的模型按14 MJ/kg有效热值: Oven-dry wood releases roughly 18–20 MJ/kg when burned. This model assumes an effective 14 MJ/kg to estimate power.
缺氧的热区里，一些碳氢分子长成多环结构，再聚成烟炱。热烟炱才会发出明亮的黄光。: In hot, oxygen-poor regions, some hydrocarbons grow into ring structures and eventually soot. Hot soot emits the bright yellow glow.
这团火每秒烧掉约 {fuel} 克可燃气，相当于 {kettles} 个电水壶的: This fire consumes about {fuel} grams of equivalent combustible gas per second, or the power of {kettles} electric kettles.
这里只展示可能出现的物质，不表示当前比例。这个流动场没有逐个计算这些分子的浓度。: These are possible constituents, not their current proportions. The flow solver does not track their individual concentrations.
这里只演示生成二氧化碳的一条配平反应，不代表炭床只走这一条路径。: This shows one balanced reaction forming carbon dioxide, not the only pathway in the coal bed.
这里只画两团碳骨架靠近、聚集，不是完整成炱反应，也不是探针测到的分子。: Two carbon frameworks approach and aggregate. This is neither the complete soot mechanism nor molecules identified by the probe.
这里画纤维素链的一个局部，两端省略。断键只作示意，不把片段冒充唯一的热解产物。: A local segment of a cellulose chain, with both ends omitted. Bond breaking illustrates fragmentation, not a unique set of pyrolysis products.
逐层累计有火的时间比例；按热烟炱或反应阈值判定，包含画面边缘淡出，从0.05 m: Accumulate flame presence in each layer using hot-soot or reaction thresholds and the display boundary fade. Height starts at the 0.05 m fuel plane. The prediction uses concurrent mean power and D=0.60 m; a log fire differs from a circular pool fire.
风会改变空气与燃料相遇的位置。: Wind changes where air and fuel meet.
观察分子时，篝火已暂停；返回后恢复原来的时间状态。: Fire time is paused here. Returning restores your previous playback state.
断开旧键需要能量，形成新键释放能量。甲烷燃烧时，后者更多，所以总体放热。: Breaking bonds requires energy; forming bonds releases it. In methane combustion, the latter releases more, so the overall reaction gives off heat.

放热、火焰高度、0.25 / 0.50 / 0.80 m处温度，以20 Hz为目: Power, flame height and temperatures at 0.25 / 0.50 / 0.80 m are sampled targeting 20 Hz. A 40-second spectrum resolves 0.025 Hz. At least two signals must show clear, nearby peaks before a frequency is reported.
